About Studomate

Mission

Studomate is a teaching tool for automation: learning, designing and simulating GRAFCET, Ladder and HMIs, right in the browser.

It exists to cut the friction of learning automation down to almost nothing: no install, no licence, no PLC to configure.

Its differentiator: everything in the same environment

Shared variables
3D scene

What Studomate offers

Editing and simulation

Automation logic: sequences, transitions, virtual I/O, timers, counters, analog values.

Clear visualisation

Active states, evaluated transitions, outputs and external effects.

Learning modes

Step-by-step, full scan and continuous execution.

3D scenes

A virtual plant (carton sorting, traffic lights, drilling, elevator) whose sensors and actuators are bound to the project's variables.

Hardware configuration

Map variables to the pins of an Arduino Uno R3 board, upload the program, simulate with real I/O and observe the board while it runs.

Analysis tools

Variable cross-references, project templates and vector PDF export.

French and English

Interface, manual and expressions available in both languages.

Educational value

Guided understanding

Of logical sequencing and causality.

Learning by trial

Test, fix, remember.

Mixed use

Classroom demos, homework exercises, collaborative corrections.

Short correction loop

Errors are flagged while editing, not only when the simulation starts.

The causality chain, made visible

Your projects are yours

Local first

Your projects are stored in your browser and can be exported as files. The schema is versioned and migrations are automatic: a project exported today will still open after updates.

Optional cloud

An account, with or without an email, lets you back up your projects to the cloud and share them by link. Without an account, nothing leaves your browser.

Open and tracker-free

The code is free under the AGPL v3 licence. Studomate uses no tracking cookies.

Target audience

Students

Technical colleges, engineering schools, universities.

Teachers and trainers

In automation and electrical engineering.

Professionals

Retraining or brushing up.
